title: feat(calendar): Add support for a start_day parameter to start weeks on Monday
body:
### Description
GitHub defaults to starting the week on Sunday, but many users prefer Monday. We should add a ?start_day=1 parameter to chunkDaysIntoWeeks logic to shift the calendar offset.

title: feat(weekday): Add hide_weekend parameter to the weekday graph
body:
### Description
Add a ?hide_weekend=true parameter that filters out Saturday and Sunday from the weekday view so developers can exclusively display their work-week activity.
